proc fastInvmod(a, modulus: BigInt): BigInt {....raises: [Exception, ValueError],
    tags: [RootEffect], forbids: [].}
a^(-1) mod modulus via binary extended GCD (HAC 14.61) on 64-bit limbs: only shifts, adds and subtracts, no divisions. Pure Nim, portable, ~4x faster than bigints.invmod at RSA sizes, so it is used unconditionally (no feature flag). Variable-time like all bigint code here -- in RSA it inverts the random blinding factor, which is the standard practice (cf. OpenSSL). Mirrors bigints.invmod errors; even moduli fall back to bigints.invmod.

proc montN0_64(n: openArray[uint64]): uint64 {....raises: [], tags: [], forbids: [].}
n0 = -n^(-1) mod 2^64. Requires odd n. The products intentionally wrap modulo 2^64 (this module compiles with checks: off, and wrapping is exactly the Newton iteration over Z/2^64Z).
